Healthcare App Development: Types, Challenges & Key Features

Reapmind Innovations / August 5, 2023

Healthcare, like most other businesses, has undergone tremendous transformations as a result of technological innovations. Smartphone medical app is becoming increasingly popular around the world, with more people using them for everything from medical treatments to general health and well-being.

So much so that, the market for mobile healthcare applications was worth $12.4 billion in 2018.By 2020, this figure has risen to $50.4 billion, and by 2025, it is predicted to have risen to $213.6 billion. There are dozens of mobile healthcare apps in the market. This essay will explain how such apps are created and what benefits they provide to the industry.

Market overview to help you understand why healthcare application is needed

The services of developing mobile healthcare apps are up for grabs. Take a look at the stats associated with the development of medical apps:

– On the App Store, there are 45,478 healthcare apps.

– On the Play Store, there are around 43,285 apps.

– In 2019, the global healthcare market got $13.7 billion.

– According to an Accenture survey, almost 75% of patients are aware of the relevance of health-related apps

– By 2026, the Telemedicine Application market will be worth $17.14 billion.

There must be a purpose for you to concentrate on the development of a mobile healthcare app. Doctors seek to improve their overall performance and connection with their patients.

The development of patient health is the major motivation for using a mobile healthcare app.

Types of healthcare application in the market

Before we begin researching how to create a medical app, you must first understand the many types of healthcare applications in the market so that you can choose the category and functionalities that are most relevant to your needs. Apps for healthcare are often categorized into two categories:

Apps for Medical Professionals:

Patient tracking, appointment scheduling, and staff management will all benefit from a doctor’s app.

User- Apps (patients, general users) :

Patients require digital health solutions to schedule appointments, communicate with doctors, and even receive advice.

Let’s take a closer look at some of the most important features and applications of each sort of software.

Medical app for Professionals

  • Working Model 

They have a complicated and diverse functioning model. The primary assumption of hospital apps is to assist hospital administration and individual clinicians in reducing friction between various processes. ReapMind healthcare app development services can assist you in creating a unique solution.

The working model can be categories as below:

  • Revenue Generation

Professional healthcare apps support doctors in developing revenue in two ways.

1. Database

2. Networking (Clinical and Patient Communication)

3. Patient Health Tracker

4. Doctor Scheduling

5. TeleHealth

6. Medical Record

7. Risk Assessment

8. Medication Prescription and Dosage

Indirectly, the creation and execution of processes fuelled by a mobile healthcare app help expedite services and save money. Direct subscriptions can also be used to earn revenue from healthcare applications.

  • Complexities

As the leading provider of mobile healthcare app ideation and development services, we understand how difficult it is to create these apps. Furthermore, one of the most popular sectors is healthcare app development. The hospitals have their systems and operational capacity. As a result, it’s critical to narrow down the goals and objectives.

It’s also difficult to create a HIPAA-compliant healthcare mobile app. To establish a healthcare application in the United States, strict privacy policies need to be in place.

As a result, before you start developing a specialty mobile healthcare app, make sure you understand the needs.

Medical App for User

  • Working model

From the standpoint of the patient, this application takes a distinct path and function. The workings of professional and patient apps may converge at some time. There is a vast segment for user medical app model like below

1. Healthcare

2. Reminder

3. Diagnosis

4. Lifestyle

5. Health Monitoring

6. Mental Health

7. Women’s Health Apps

8. Doctor on-demand

  • Revenue Generation

This type of healthcare application generates a lot of money. You can assist patients with excellent pain-relieving remedies. Charge a subscription for the same to make revenue. In-app purchases are one of the most effective ways to increase money from a medical app.

Only 5.76 percent of Google Playstore apps are charged; the remainder is free and uses an in-app payment mechanism.

Give consumers a free trial first, even if your goal is to charge them for using the software.

  • Challenges

The patient segment is vast than that of designing a professional medical app or hospital app. Furthermore, medical app development for patients must be driven by the market. So one needs to get deep into the market and strategize the services one wishes to serve the market with.

A fascinating competitive cluster needs to be added for idea validation and to help attract the audience to your user healthcare application.

Key features a healthcare application must have

Let’s take a look at some essential elements that should be included in any high-performance healthcare application.

Every medical application should be simple and easy to use. They must be coupled with the best data security measures because they store a lot of patient information. But, beyond these essential elements, what are the value-added features that will make your app stand out in a crowded mobile app development market? Let’s have a look at a few of them:

  • Tracking

Monitoring the patient’s vital indicators, such as blood pressure, heart rate, blood sugar levels, pulse, calorie intake, and so on, is the most important element of any patient app.

  • Reminders and Scheduling

This function allows patients to schedule doctor visits with ease. It may also set reminders for taking medicine, sleeping, drinking water, and meeting daily calorie goals, among other things.

  • Information of Physicians

Patients can search for doctors by specialty, availability, location, and other criteria using this function. They can also conduct extensive research on a doctor’s background before scheduling an appointment.

  • Database of Patient Data

This feature allows the hospital app to retain prescriptions, medical histories, reports, and other sensitive information that patients and doctors can access at any time.

  • Chats in Real-Time

Patients can communicate with their doctors in real-time and receive prompt support with this tool. This feature can make healthcare more accessible and build trust between doctors and patients.

  • Geolocation

Consider a patient who is unable to reach his usual healthcare facility and requires quick treatment. Patients can be informed about nearby hospitals using this feature and integrated map services. In the event of an emergency, it can also assist healthcare providers in locating a patient.

  • Ratings and reviews

Patients can submit helpful comments and share their treatment experiences with other patients using this tool. Patients will be able to make better decisions as a result of this, the healthcare provider will gain credibility and patient loyalty.

  • Payment Gateway

Patients can safely and conveniently pay for treatment and/or insurance using mobile payment integration with the newest digital payment capabilities like wallets, credit/debit cards, net banking, etc. Patients can also obtain copies of bills to document them.
